_comment: Soul larva, fresh state. Per project_soul_larvae_cosmology: judged soul that just arrived at Acheron, imprint set but inward-firing has not yet built. Crawls from spawn anchor to shore, then stands at shore until enough wall-time passes for the inward-burn to hollow it out -- at which point the spawn-flow's on_arrival action swaps the archetype to larva_aged. Cosmologically the form closest to a freshly-deceased human walking. Visual differentiation from the Vagrant comes from texture (leached pale) and clip set (slow crawl) -- mesh + rig are shared per universal-humanoid-enemy-rule.
_comment_faction: Fresh larvae are NOT aggro-able. faction=Neutral gates the perception ladder at Unaware (tickPerception's faction check returns early). The applyArchetypeSwap to larva_aged later flips faction=Hostile via the new archetype's faction field.
_comment_mesh_path_variants: Per FromSoft-pattern authoring workflow: this archetype ships pre-baked mesh variants. Spawn code rolls uniformly across the list so a crowd of larvae has mixed variants. All variants share the humanoid_male skeleton_id bundle's clip library (52-bone mixamo skeleton, same in every bake) so animations cross-play. See docs/enemies.md.
_comment_stubbed_female_variant: Female variant baked at assets/characters/enemies/larva_fresh_female/humanoid.glb but temporarily excluded from mesh_path_variants: the humanoid_female skeleton has spine-curvature issues on several of the newer clips. Re-add 'assets/characters/enemies/larva_fresh_female/humanoid.glb' to mesh_path_variants when the female clip set + rig are stable. Skin diffuse + baked glb are already shipped so re-enabling is a one-line change.
_comment_random_face_morphs: Enemy is crowd-spawned (up to 8 concurrent from the acheron_larvae spawn-flow). Randomize per-actor face structure (nose / cheek bones / chin / eye position / lip volume) so no two larvae look identical. Uses selva::gameplay::rollRandomFaceMorphs; excludes scale morphs by design (no head-size or eye-size drift).
_comment_character_path: Per figura umana: same humanoid rig, deformed per being. Fresh larvae are noticeably small (body_scale=0.60, leached pale color) -- the imprint has not yet hollowed them out into the aged form. The transform_target_archetype below points at larva_aged; while a fresh larva waits at the shore, resolveAppearance lerps body_scale + color from THIS appearance toward larva_aged's appearance, so the player watches the larva grow AND redden simultaneously as the inward-burn progresses. Future deformation axes (gauntness, hunch) will layer on top and be lerped too without code changes.
_comment_disable_hurtboxes: Fresh larvae cannot be killed. Cosmologically: the Vagrant's second-death-grant works on substance that has already loosened (per the inward-imprint mechanism). Fresh larvae are still tightly arranged -- intact soul-form, no internal disruption. The Vagrant's swings pass through them. See [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] 'Fresh larvae are NOT killable'.
_comment_intangible: Fresh larvae share physical space with the Vagrant -- the substance is too loosely arranged to displace flesh, and the player must be able to walk through the pile without being blocked or shoved. Puts the actor in the INCORPOREAL physics layer: gravity + ground snap intact (they still crawl on terrain and hazard-avoid the shoreline), but the player, other actors, and other larvae pass through them. On the arrival-swap to larva_aged the layer flips to Solid; the aged form's substance has hollowed enough to displace flesh. Doctrine parallel to disable_hurtboxes: substance-arrangement drives what physics can and cannot touch.
_comment_examine: Examinable via the lang-map keys (literal examine_text is empty -- the lang map is authoritative). Per the insight-system doctrine, every examine fires an insight node (knows_arrival_queue, declared in config/insight/world.json); the language-map entries promote tier-1 the moment that node fires. Tier-2 fires when the Guide subsequently names the cosmology (topic in config/npcs/guide.json with unlocks_insight=guide_named_arrival_queue). Tier-1 strings stay observational/functional only -- no 'soul' / 'imprint' / 'queue-of-the-dead' until tier-2.
_comment_spawn_clip: Fresh larvae spawn ALREADY in the crawl pose, not in the standing zombie_idle. Without this, the spawn pipeline binds idle_clip on frame 0 and the gait picker swaps to zombie_crawl on frame 1+; the actor renders as 'standing for a split second' before going prone. spawn_clip overrides the frame-0 bind. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] -- the larva is never standing; it emerges already crawling.
_comment_idle: Idle clip plays once the fresh larva has arrived at its scripted target and is waiting for the on_arrival_delay to expire. zombie_idle is a standing-pose loop; cosmologically wrong for a not-yet-stood-up larva, but loopable + harmless. Polish-deferred: a low/prone idle authored against the crawl pose would be ideal here.
_comment_physical_reactions: Flinch + hit_react clips left at humanoid defaults. Moot for fresh larvae (no hurtboxes; no incoming hits) but preserved for the post-swap aged archetype semantics.
_comment_sangue_drop: Fresh larvae are normally unkillable by the Vagrant (disable_hurtboxes=true). The drop fires only when the paired-corpse FIFO consumes a fresh as part of the feeding cycle (HP->0 via consumption). Smaller than aged because the fresh imprint is barely loosened. Placeholder per [[project_imprint_handle_required_for_sangue]] -- pending the keeper-fall ledger.
_comment_transform_target_archetype: While the fresh larva waits at the shore for the on_arrival_delay to expire, resolveAppearance lerps the WHOLE Appearance (color, body_scale, every future axis) from this archetype's appearance toward larva_aged's appearance over the wait duration. The player watches the larva go from small-and-pale to full-sized-and-sangue-red, and at the moment the lerp completes (t=1.0), the archetype swap fires + the larva stands up feral. Cosmologically the transformation IS the inward-burn made visible. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]].
